title: Review Checkpoint: Picker Reliable, Cost-Controlled, On Target
goal: After #330-#332, confirm the picker is now (a) parse-failure-free, (b) resilient to transient failures, (c) measurably cheaper per advance. Decide go/no-go for Phase 4 (cross-target + verifier).
scope: Live run for at least 30 picker advances across 2 different runs (one Gruyere, one non-Gruyere). Measure parse-fail rate, retry rate, cost per advance from logs. Written checkpoint report with go/no-go on Phase 4.
generation_reason: Per operator request, a checkpoint after Phase 3 confirms picker hardening before Phase 4 (cross-target chains + verifier) is started. Cost data is critical: the original 2026-05-15 analysis showed ~$300/day, with caching + Phase 3 expected to land under $100/day.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Review only. No production code changes. Output is a checkpoint report and a yes/no decision on Phase 4 promotion.
constraints.evidence_requirement: Report must cite real numbers from logs: parse-fail count, retry count, avg input/output/cache tokens per hop, estimated daily cost.

success_criteria: docs/checkpoints/2026-mythos-phase3-review.md exists with: (a) parse-fail rate across 30+ advances, (b) retry-survival count, (c) avg cost per advance pre vs post Phase 3, (d) any deviation from #330-#332 plans, (e) explicit go/no-go for Phase 4.
Parse-fail rate is 0% over the test window.
Estimated daily cost (extrapolated from sample) is at most 35% of pre-Phase-3 baseline (was ~$300/day; target ~$100/day).
AGENT_SYSTEM_MAP.md section 2 'Known issues' on JSON parse and memory bloat are updated or removed.
If go: backlog-384 is promoted into NEXT_TASK.md. If no-go: corrective task is named and queued.

acceptance_criteria: Cost reduction is empirical, not aspirational.
Parse-fail count is documented as a concrete number, ideally 0.
Phase 4 go/no-go decision is explicit and justified.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
Tasks #330, #331, #332 must show as DONE in DONE_LOG.md.
after_completion: Promote backlog-384 (or corrective task) into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Reopening Phase 3 scope unless drift is documented.
